title: [v0.92.1][Sprint 4] Corporate acceptance
body:
## Outcome

Coordinate Sprint 4 — Corporate acceptance as one bounded execution wave without absorbing child implementation.

## Current child membership baseline

- #497 — CORP-C corporate IP-transfer acceptance. PR #613 merged; post-closeout truth repair routes broader operational control-plane hardening to sidecar #624 so those gaps do not block #497 transfer acceptance.
- #498 — CORP-D corporate diligence acceptance. This remains the active Sprint 4 child before umbrella closeout.

## Nonblocking sidecar

- #624 tracks post-move-in operational control-plane hardening discovered during #497 review/closeout: GitHub/CI authority, DNS/certificate ownership, AWS guardrails, private custody receipt, and deployment rollback readback. #624 is important follow-up work, but it is not a Sprint 4 closure blocker unless a later operator-approved sprint policy explicitly makes it one.

- Membership version: `5`
- Change reason: Route #497 operational hardening residuals to sidecar #624 and keep Sprint 4 focused on corporate IP-transfer and diligence acceptance.

## Change protocol

- This roster is the opening baseline, not a permanent freeze.
- The milestone operator may add, remove, split, or reroute work through a typed issue update that records the reason and rechecks dependencies.
- Every update must preserve one bounded result per child and must not silently drop unfinished work.

## Completion gate

- Every child in the current declared roster has an independently reviewed, green merge into `main` and its merge commit is ancestral to the sprint closing revision.
- Blocked or deferred children retain an explicit operator-approved disposition; the umbrella never fabricates completion.
- Typed finish and worktree cleanup are asynchronous and never gate another issue.
- Sidecar #624 remains open follow-up and does not block Sprint 4 closeout.

## Concrete result

One reviewable Sprint 4 result records the current roster version, dispositions, reviewed merge heads, green checks, merge commits, ancestry, and nonblocking sidecar routing.

## Non-goals

- Implementing child work inside this umbrella.
- Serializing children that have no declared dependency.
- Treating closeout or cleanup as an execution dependency.
- Completing #624 inside Sprint 4.
